provenance.rule: Heuristic/discovery evidence may classify or design but cannot mint ACCEPTED or AVAILABLE.

version_contract.increment_owner: InstrumentAuthority only; exact next version generated under serialized transition
version_contract.progression: strict monotonic; no duplicates; no gaps policy NOT_FROZEN
version_contract.coherence: current.metadata_version > max(history.metadata_version); initial current v1 permits empty history

transition_semantics.new_product: mint new instrument_id only after genuine admission proof
transition_semantics.metadata_update: same identity and instrument_id; archive old current then authority increments version
transition_semantics.delist: new immutable version with DELISTED status; identity retained
transition_semantics.relist: NOT_FROZEN (same identity/version progression versus new identity)
transition_semantics.source_metadata_change: new version only after exact genuine ASCAT member authorization
transition_semantics.symbol_reuse: NOT_FROZEN; must not silently alias prior product
transition_semantics.identity_collision: DENY and fail closed; no overwrite

source_provenance.admission_source: candidate genuine ASCAT member + genuine Workspace policy/admission context, but policy contract is NOT_FROZEN

ordering: genuine ASCAT -> Instrument version admission -> WCP projection admission; WCP cannot mint Instrument or cite itself

sources: authoritative current record on exact match
authoritative historical record on exact match

negative_requirements: current Instrument substitutes missing requested old version -> FAIL
